q1_issues.issue: The "between Boston Red Sox and Cincinnati Reds" PP is promoted to two `Agent` atoms on the playing event (statements 3 and 4), but the clause is an agentless passive whose agent atom the instruction set says to omit, so the teams' doing of the playing is added rather than stated.

q2_gaps: "another N": an additive determiner presupposing a prior instance of the kind — the instruction set covers event-level "again" (`Again`) and "also" (`Also`) but gives no encoding for NP-level "another", so the presupposition is silently dropped

"between X and Y": a two-object preposition — the preposition-named oblique form takes a single object, and no rule maps a between-participants phrase onto a thematic role (the collective-Agent licence in Coordination & plurals is for "between them" on a plural subject, not for a between-PP naming the participants)
notes: `Theme` for the played series follows the instruction set's unclear-case default, and "in Havana" is correctly an event `Location`. All three proper nouns carry their `Name` atoms.
